title: Det Levende Arkivet
purpose: A browser-based demonstration of signed, content-addressed instruments and linked provenance records.

prototype_features.signatures: Ed25519 using the browser Web Crypto API
prototype_features.payload_cid: CIDv1, raw codec and sha2-512 multihash, unless an external CID is supplied
prototype_features.instrument_cid: CIDv1, raw codec and sha2-512 multihash over the canonical instrument including its signature
prototype_features.chain: Each instrument references the previous instrument CID; genesis uses the GENESIS marker and SELF root marker
prototype_features.storage: Records in browser local storage; non-extractable signing key in IndexedDB
prototype_features.ipfs: Optional user-triggered local Kubo raw-block upload and pin for payloads up to 2 MiB

limitations: Local browser records are not a global or first-writer-wins registry.
The prototype does not automatically retrieve or re-hash payload bytes during later chain verification.
A valid signature proves control of the corresponding private key, not a real-world identity, factual truth, trusted time, or legal effect.
The standalone page does not implement Pinata uploads or store Pinata API credentials.
The prototype does not establish legal jurisdiction, ownership, or statutory rights.
observer_model: The home page describes where source files, browser records and keys, public site assets, and optional local Kubo uploads reside.
